content: A friend who stands with you during the dry drought is worth more than ten thousand who celebrate at the harvest feast.
author: African Proverbs
explanation: When the millet is tall, the cattle are fat, and the palm wine flows, every neighbor claims to love you. But when drought scorches the grass and the granary is empty, only genuine love remains to share its last scoop of grain. Value those who held your hand in the dust.
practicalInsight: Check in on someone who is walking through a hard season today. Be the faithful friend in their drought.
reflectionPrompt: Who stood by you when you had nothing to offer, and how can you honor their loyalty?
